items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Eliza, a little girl, genius girl next door.

ctx.x: Interviewed me about this record. And I hadn’t heard it in years. And I listened to it once but I never wanted to hear it again. (laughs) ‘Cause it had been… Oh, I think volume, not that… Yeah, I had to get Metheny to… I don’t know… I think I told you. Eliza, a little girl, genius girl next door. I went to a recital that her guitar teacher had. It was so goddamn loud, I could not believe it. It was dangerously loud, and everything seems to be like that. I don’t get it.
And you’re not the first person that said that this week to us.
